title: DSDD dogfood proof: Story Mode must not block local DSDD intent
humanStatement: DSDD should work with no local/cloud configuration. After PlotPickle starts, the Human should be able to open DSDD, talk or type, and continue immediately.
observedBefore: A DSDD TEST narration was rejected because Story Mode was CLOUD while the explicit DSDD text route was local Ollama.
understoodMeaning: The authenticated developer DSDD intent interpreter is a local engineering capability and must not inherit creative Story Mode locality policy. Ordinary Story Mode routing remains unchanged.
approvedMeaning: Continue fixing DSDD until green, preserving local-only behavior and the existing deterministic merge boundary.

buildInstruction.change: Mark only the DSDD local text request with a PlotPickle-owned intent scope and let that request bypass Story Mode locality enforcement.

requirements.text: DSDD local intent generation is not rejected by Story Mode locality policy.
Ordinary Story Mode locality policy remains in force outside explicitly scoped DSDD intent requests.
Human live dogfood confirms the post-fix DSDD reply in the owned Edge window.
evidence: Requires Human re-test on merged main; no automated gate may substitute for this live observation.
